title: How Mental Health Self-Disclosure Becomes Visible: Evidence from Eight Conditions on Reddit
abstract: arXiv:2608.29010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People share mental health diagnoses on social media, yet how such language becomes visible around their self-disclosure, and whether community engagement tracks it, remain unexamined across conditions. We analyze 89,605 Reddit posts from 739 users across eight conditions, removing each user's diagnosis disclosure and aligning their surrounding posts to that anchor. Within the pre-disclosure year, language-visible burden was highest in the month before disclosure for six conditions, earlier for post-traumatic stress disorder and furthest from it for borderline personality disorder, and remained visible afterward rather than resolving. The theme Seeking Clinical Explanations showed the largest early-to-late difference before disclosure in five conditions, yet engagement rarely tracked what users wrote: only 9 of 360 language--engagement correlations survived correction. Disclosure is therefore a waypoint in an unevenly visible process,

translated_title: 心理健康自我披露如何变得可见：来自Reddit八种疾病的证据
translated_abstract: 人们在社交媒体上分享心理健康诊断，然而这类语言如何在自我披露前后变得可见，以及社区互动是否随之变化，在不同疾病间仍未被研究。我们分析了来自739名用户、涉及八种疾病的89,605条Reddit帖子，移除每位用户的诊断披露内容，并将其前后的帖子对齐到该时间锚点。在披露前的一年内，六种疾病的语言可见负担在披露前一个月达到最高，创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）出现得更早，而边缘型人格障碍（BPD）则距离披露时间最远；且这种负担在披露后依然可见，而非随之消解。“寻求临床解释”这一主题在五种疾病中显示出披露前后最大的早期至晚期差异，但社区互动很少跟随用户所写的内容：360个语言—互动相关性中仅有9个在校正后仍然显著。因此，自我披露是一个不均匀可见过程中的一个节点。
tldr: 该研究通过对739名用户在八种心理疾病中的近9万条Reddit帖子进行以诊断披露为锚点的时间对齐分析，发现语言层面的心理负担在自我披露前数月即已显现且披露后持续存在，但社区互动几乎不随这些语言变化而改变。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 89,605 Reddit posts from 739 users across eight mental health conditions aligned to diagnosis disclosure, this study reveals that linguistic signs of psychological burden become visible months before disclosure and persist afterward, yet community engagement rarely tracks these language changes.
